subject: Discovery recap — token bands, unit economics target and trial top-up
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jing Li <jing.li@aurabio.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-09T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap — token bands, unit economics target and trial top-up

Hi Jing (and Tom),

Thanks again for the call earlier — quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on economics before we spin up the pilot environment.

Key points I captured:
- Primary inference workload: document classification + light summarization (mostly 2–4k tokens per request).
- Expected steady-state: ~8–12M tokens / month; expected peak windows up to 22–28M tokens in a burst week.
- Budget sensitivity: Aurabio indicated a target spend range of $20k–$35k / month for this pilot stage.
- Target unit economics: you mentioned a target of ~$20 / 1M tokens as the aspiration for procurement.

To move forward we need two confirmations from you:
1) Finalize the target monthly bands you want Redwood to model for pricing (steady / peak).
2) Confirm whether you want Redwood to approve a short-term credit top-up to cover an initial stress test (details below).

Immediate ask from our side:
- If you want to run the week-long stress test you described, please confirm you’d like a 500k-token trial top-up (we can grant this as one-off API credits).
- If you prefer, we can instead set a time-limited discount band for the first month to keep spend predictable while you validate output quality.

Attached: pilot_plan_v1.pdf (lightweight plan + expected QA prompts).

Next steps:
- Jing: confirm token bands (steady / peak) and which credit option you prefer by end of Thursday.
- Camila/Marissa: if Aurabio confirms top-up, prepare a one-page addendum (credit terms) and schedule the stress-test window.
- I’ll loop in Neha for final sign-off on credits.

Thanks — looking forward to a short pilot.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: pilot_plan_v1.pdf (PDF, 78KB)]

From: Jing Li <jing.li@aurabio.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@aurabio.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — token bands, unit economics target and trial top-up

Sergio — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers below: 

- Confirmed steady-state band: 10M tokens / month.
- Peak window: up to ~25M tokens in a burst week (exploratory search + batch reranks).
- Budget: SAP/Procurement has allocated $28k–$32k / month for the pilot phase.
- Target: procurement will fight for ~$18 / 1M tokens but we can tolerate up to ~$22 / 1M if latency and quality hold.

We do want to run the stress test you mentioned; please approve a 500k-token credit top-up to cover the first integrated run next Tuesday. I attached a small usage snapshot from our internal simulator so you can see request-size distribution.

Attaching: usage_snapshot.csv

Tom is on copy for procurement oversight — he’ll confirm budget routing if needed.

Thanks,
Jing
Head of ML Ops | Aurabio
jing.li@aurabio.com
[Attachment: usage_snapshot.csv (CSV, 12KB)]

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jing Li <jing.li@aurabio.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — token bands, unit economics target and trial top-up

On Wed, Jun 10, 2026 at 10:05 AM Jing Li <jing.li@aurabio.com> wrote:
> We do want to run the stress test you mentioned; please approve a 500k-token credit top-up to cover the first integrated run next Tuesday.

Thanks Jing — that works. We can provision a one-off 500k token credit for Aurabio to use for the stress test on the agreed window. Conditions: credit is one-time, applied to the pilot project, and intended for validation runs only (production use beyond the pilot will be billed per our standard rates).

Camila/Marissa: please prepare the short addendum with the credit line and a suggested date/time for the stress run (Jing asked for next Tue).

Neha — looping you in for accounting sign-off. I’ve attached the pilot plan for reference.

Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: pilot_plan_v1.pdf (PDF, 78KB)]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Discovery recap — token bands, unit economics target and trial top-up

Hi Jing and team —

Following Sergio’s note, finance has approved a one-time 500k-token credit to be applied to Aurabio’s pilot account. A few administrative notes: 
- Credit amount: 500,000 API tokens, expires 30 days after issuance.
- Applies to project: aurabio-pilot-DEAL-5842.
- This credit is not transferrable and is intended for evaluation/stress-test only.

Next steps from us:
1) I’ll drop a DocuSign addendum for the one-off credit; please sign to acknowledge the credit terms.
2) Camila will coordinate the stress-test window and confirm the time.
3) Once test completes we’ll send a short usage & cost recap.

DocuSign link (one-time): https://app.redwoodinference.com/docusign/DEAL-5842
Attaching the signed credit approval stub: docu-sign-credit-approval.pdf

If you want the credit applied immediately, reply with the preferred start date/time and we’ll schedule it.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
